title_en: Fall 2026 Application for Recognition of Graduate Course Credits Across Degree Programs
summary: Graduate students who wish to have course credits earned in a Seoul National University bachelor's or master's program recognised toward their bachelor's-to-master's or master's-to-doctoral program must apply online through MySNU and submit the signed printed application with a marked transcript. The deadline is 5:00 p.m. on Monday, 21 September 2026, and documents must be submitted to the department office (Building 301, Room 319). Students are asked to apply in their first semester of admission, and students who have already been approved may not reapply.
applies_to: Graduate students who wish to have credits earned between the bachelor's and master's programs, or between the master's and doctoral programs, recognised (credit transfer). Only credits earned in a Seoul National University bachelor's or master's program are eligible; credits from other universities are not. Master's-to-doctoral recognition applies only to students who advanced from the master's program to the doctoral program in the SNU School of Electrical and Information Engineering (전기정보공학부, including 전컴). Application is voluntary for those who wish to have credits recognised, and is requested in the first semester of admission. Students already approved may not reapply.

Recommended time to apply, for smooth academic administration
dates.when: In the first semester after admission

conditions: Students who have already been approved may not apply again.
Only credits earned in a Seoul National University bachelor's or master's program are eligible; credits from other universities are not.
Only courses in the same or a similar major with a grade of B0 or higher may be submitted.
Courses graded S/U may not be submitted.
A graduate-level course whose content is at the undergraduate level of the School of Electrical and Information Engineering may not be recognised.
The Graduate School of Data Science courses 'Programming for Data Science' and 'Foundations of Mathematics and Statistics for Data Science' are not recognised.
Bachelor's-to-master's: a maximum of 6 credits may be recognised.
Bachelor's-to-master's: only graduate courses taken during the SNU bachelor's program and classified as 'Graduate' (대학원) are eligible.
Bachelor's-to-master's: courses classified as 일선, 전선 or 전필 were reclassified to count toward undergraduate graduation and cannot be recognised.
Master's-to-doctoral: a maximum of 12 credits may be recognised.
Master's-to-doctoral: only course credits taken in the master's program in excess of 24 credits can be recognised (for example, 27 credits taken gives 3 additional credits).
Master's-to-doctoral: only 6 thesis research credits count, so any thesis research credits above 6 are deducted from the recognised credits.

In departments that do not count common competency (공통역량) courses toward completion credits, those credits are excluded when calculating excess master's credits; check with the department office whether this applies.
Students who are not Fall 2026 new students must write their admission year and semester in pencil below their signature on the application.
steps: Read the attached application guide and the attached notice of 7 September 2026 for details (the attachment content was not read for this translation).
Apply online in MySNU: Student Services (학생서비스) > Classes/Grades (수업/성적) > Credit Recognition Application (학점인정신청) > Recognition Across Programs (과정간 통산인정) > Apply (신청하기).
Print the application form (신청서 출력) from the system.
Sign the application yourself and obtain your supervisor's signature (or seal); both are required.
If you are not a Fall 2026 new student, write your admission year and semester in pencil below your signature.
Prepare your transcript with the courses you are applying for marked on it.
Submit the printed application and the marked transcript to the staff member in the department office (Building 301, Room 319) by 5:00 p.m. on Monday, 21 September 2026.
translation:
Fall 2026 Application for Recognition of Graduate Course Credits Across Programs (Bachelor's–Master's, Master's–Doctoral)

1. Eligible applicants
Graduate students who wish to have credits completed between the bachelor's and master's programs, or between the master's and doctoral programs, recognised.
※ For smooth academic administration, please apply in your first semester of admission. Students who have already been approved may not reapply!!
※ Only credits completed in a Seoul National University bachelor's or master's program are eligible (other universities do not apply).

2. Online application and submission of documents
A. Deadline: by 5:00 p.m. on Monday, 21 September 2026
B. After applying online, print the application and submit it to the staff member in the department office (Building 301, Room 319).
* MySNU > Student Services (학생서비스) > Classes/Grades (수업/성적) > Credit Recognition Application (학점인정신청) > Recognition Across Programs (과정간 통산인정) > Apply (신청하기) > Print application (신청서 출력) > Your own signature and your supervisor's signature (or seal) on the application are required > Submit to the department office staff member.
* If you are not a Fall 2026 new student, write your admission year and semester in pencil below your signature field on the application.
* Documents to submit: please submit the application for credit recognition (printed from the system) together with your transcript (with the courses applied for marked).
* How to apply: see the attachment (Guide to Applying for Recognition of Graduate Course Credits). [The attachment was not read.]

3. Recognised credits
★ Eligible courses: same or similar major, grade B0 or higher. ※ S/U courses may not be submitted!!
★ Even if a course applied for is a graduate course, it may not be recognised if its content is at the undergraduate level of the School of Electrical and Information Engineering.
☆ Courses not recognised: (Graduate School of Data Science) 'Programming for Data Science' and 'Foundations of Mathematics and Statistics for Data Science'.

A. Bachelor's–master's recognition
1) Scope: up to a maximum of 6 credits.
2) Of the graduate courses taken during the SNU bachelor's program, only those classified as 'Graduate' (대학원) may be submitted.
3) Courses marked 일선, 전선, 전필, etc. are cases in which the classification was changed so that they count toward undergraduate graduation credits, and they cannot be recognised.

B. Master's–doctoral recognition
1) Scope: up to a maximum of 12 credits.
2) Recognition is possible only for students who advanced from the master's program to the doctoral program in the SNU School of Electrical and Information Engineering (including 전컴), and only for master's course credits taken in excess of 24 credits.
Example: if you took 27 credits in the master's program, 3 credits beyond the 24 are recognised.
3) Of the credits completed in the master's program, only 6 thesis research credits are counted, so if thesis research courses exceed 6 credits, the excess must be deducted from the recognised course credits.
Example 1: 30 master's credits completed, 6 thesis research credits → master's credits completed (30) − credits required for master's completion (24) = 6 credits recognised.
Example 2: 30 master's credits completed, 9 thesis research credits → master's credits completed (30) − credits required for master's completion (24) − excess thesis research credits (3) = 3 credits recognised.

- Attachment: Guide to Applying for Recognition of Graduate Course Credits
- Inquiries: department office (Building 301, Room 319); the contact person and email are given in the original notice.
※ When calculating excess master's credits, departments that do not include common competency (공통역량) courses in completion credits will exclude those credits. Please check with the department office whether this applies.
※ For details, please see the attached notice dated 7 September 2026.
